name: bibliotheca
description: Bibliotheca - Every Book. One Library. Smart book cataloging and digital library management.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
